### 2026-11-01: Thought that it would be kinda boring if it just changed a little so I tweaked the code, and now when you put your hand over the motion sensor, it will play a small animation that keeps going for abou

**2h**

Thought that it would be kinda boring if it just changed a little so I tweaked the code, and now when you put your hand over the motion sensor, it will play a small animation that keeps going for about 3 seconds after it stops detecting motion. also went back into onshape and added a bit to the tv. I gave it a bottom cus I realized that I didn't have one originally so the pieces would've just fallen out, also gave it legs, filllet'd the edges of it, and put a TETO sign on it. thinking to maybe find a way to engrave some art into the sides

![Screenshot 2026-11-01 4.03.02 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/RLfnF7qHkUwCrekQNa6pAHouKTonALg9/ee8d4691f3c89cd5996fb621cb49118bc819a1b5bd9b91d713ad284a300b5e4d.png)

hour 2:

so I went onto my phone and did a quick doodle which is what I wanted to put into on shape ( I know its ugly but bear with me I didn't have time to create a masterpiece)

![Screenshot 2026-11-01 4.31.52 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/RLfnF7qHkUwCrekQNa6pAHouKTonALg9/82e39963e3c6ce600c705085a9d56fc971f214135205762c10e03474530894bd.png)

and I found an online converter and changed it to a DXF file and then went into on shape. I uploaded it butttt it said it couldn't process the geometry of it. I guess the outline should have been simpler.. i'll keep that in mind for next time.
anyways I tried to create an outline of her head using the tool that lets you connect dots you place, but I think I placed too many bc it just made my computer crash :sob:
sooo after that I just ended up drawing a music note on the side and removing it but just a little so that it's engraved into the wall rather than a hole in it.
and that's it!! i'm done
